description: This file contains definitions for difficulty levels, detailed prompt templates, and functions to generate medical education MCQs and validation prompts for exam preparation.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating a medical MCQ based on difficulty, context, and image context, including instructions, explanation format, and response structure.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating a generated MCQ, focusing on accuracy, clarity, and scenario realism.
